instruction: Work with command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral hierarchical full-adder design `fulladd` is on the desktop. Flatten its schematic hierarchy and Write the required deliverables into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Requirements: - `flat.json` must contain `root_schematic`, `total_primitive_parts`, and `hier_block_expansions`. - Hierarchical blocks themselves do not count as primitive parts. - Each hierarchy expansion entry must include `parent`, `ref`, and `child`. [Software] For this task, the available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`.
